research_question: Can category-level word-region supervision of existing CSA decoder object attention improve CIDEr and reduce object hallucination without losing recall?
scope: Focused comparison of three primary methods, not systematic retrieval or novelty clearance.

sources.title: Grounded Video Description
assistant_read_scope: Visual inspection of PDF page 5 equations
source_supported_claims: Supervised attention, region classification and grounding losses alongside caption loss.
Original attention term is -sum gamma_i log alpha_i, not marginal positive-set mass.
Positive regions overlap annotated object boxes with IoU > 0.5.
Table 2 ANet validation: Unsup CIDEr 44.6 vs Sup. Attn. 47.0.
Table 4 Flickr30k Entities test: Our Unsup. (w/o SelfAttn) CIDEr 60.1 vs full GVD 62.3; not attention-only effect.
Page 6 explicitly says method not applied to COCO because of absent exact word-box correspondence and 80-category annotations.
limits_and_adaptation: Evidence does not establish CSA/COCO CHAIR reduction.
Proposal borrows direct attention supervision, not full GVD encoding/classification/grounding architecture.

sources.title: Neural Baby Talk
assistant_read_scope: Visual inspection of PDF page 5 equations
source_supported_claims: Region/sentinel pointer creates slots and lexical refinement emits visual words.
Equation 13 includes -log((1/m) sum positive region probability), coupled with refinement likelihood.
For a fixed positive set, positive mean vs sum differs by an additive log m for gradients of the region distribution.
COCO weak category-word mapping uses 80 categories and 413 fine-grained labels.
Positive proposals require IoU > 0.5 and category agreement with detector prediction; unmatched words use textual path.
limits_and_adaptation: Proposal borrows multi-positive category matching and marginalization, not full NBT.
Removing detector category agreement and using actual CSA Transformer attention are project adaptations.
Weak category grounding does not disambiguate same-class instances.

sources.title: Efficient Image Captioning for Edge Devices
assistant_read_scope: Start of section 3.3 for distillation scope; abstract
source_supported_claims: Frozen CLIP grid features, region concept extractor projected into CLIP text space, and concept-conditioned channel modulation.
Pretraining uses caption and concept-corruption contrastive objectives; caption-only fine-tuning described.
Final system results include pretraining/distillation/ensemble effects.
limits_and_adaptation: Concept similarity is not verified presence.
Random concept replacement may create false negatives; no adoption as absence ground truth.
Not selected for first pilot; no verified CHAIR improvement for current CSA.

proposed_not_established.mechanism: Final decoder layer actual pre-dropout object attention, averaged across 8 heads; positive mass loss on category-matched TRAIN ROI sets.
proposed_not_established.loss: L_XE + lambda * mean_eligible(-log sum_positive a); lambda=0.1 proposed.
proposed_not_established.labels: All noncrowd instances of the category; IoU>=0.5 proposed; uncertain/crowd/absent-positive cases skipped for grounding only.
proposed_not_established.false_negatives: Outside-positive regions remain implicit softmax competitors; missing annotations and low-IoU support remain risks.
proposed_not_established.pilot: 10k TRAIN audit; two matched 2000-update arms from fixed CSA10; full VALID5000; no TEST tuning.
proposed_not_established.success_thresholds: Proposed before approval, not empirically validated; see proposal.

verification_limits.independent_review: One native same-family agent technical critique; not human or cross-family verification.
